title: Stevie Wonder files lawsuit to evict woman who allegedly lived in his home rent-free for nearly 40 years
summary: Stevie Wonder has filed a lawsuit against Carmen Efferson, who allegedly lived rent-free in his Studio City, California, home since 1988, following a dispute over a property inspection.
